audit.why: 56.01% over 857 games with diff 4/10 FAV and carry threat 10/10 is exactly right for a lane Olaf owns until Nasus's second item.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers gave Olaf every row except Level 6, including First item and 2+ items — while the whys directly under those rows say Wither zeroes his passive at Sheen and that a stacked Nasus shrugs off flat true damage. The page tells the player he wins the exact stage it also tells him he loses.
audit.why: Nasus is a 10/10 carry threat by the page's own rating; a chart that hands Olaf the two-item stage is the opposite of the matchup and of the packet chart.
audit.corrected: Chart re-proposed as one atomic group in both layers: Olaf, Olaf, Skill, Olaf, Skill, Nasus, Nasus. Ratings moved with the sides. Row 6 is set to Nasus rather than the packet's Skill because the prose, the 10/10 carry rating and the late-game text all describe a takeover, not a coin flip.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two hard errors. First, both layers claim Ragnarok cleanses Wither ('R cleanses it', 'Ragnarok cleanses his wither', 'pop R to cleanse the wither'). Ragnarok grants immunity to disables while Olaf keeps attacking; Wither is a Move Speed and Attack Speed decay, and it lands and persists through Ragnarok. Second, the content layer twice says Nasus has no Wither until level 6 ('he has no W wither until 6', 'respect his wither once he hits 6'). Wither is his W and is available from level 2.
audit.why: This is the matchup's decisive interaction and the page had it backwards in both directions. A player who ults into Wither expecting a cleanse commits a 100s cooldown into a fight where his attack speed is still crippled. The mirror audit reached the same conclusion: Wither lands through Ragnarok, so spend R on the engage rather than saving it as an answer.
audit.corrected: Every 'R cleanses Wither' line rewritten to state that Ragnarok clears disables, not slows, and that Wither must be baited. The 'no Wither until 6' claim replaced with Wither's real availability and 15/14/13/12/11s cooldown. Level 1 named as the only Wither-free window. Siphoning Strike given its 255 range and 7.5s rank-1 cooldown as the reason Nasus must walk into Undertow range to stack.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect confirmed: no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere, and zero numbers.
audit.why: Wither at 15s rank 1 is the punishable window and the whole all-in plan hangs on baiting it.
audit.corrected: Wither's 15s and Siphoning Strike's 7.5s written into the cooldown breakdown, and the all-in window rewritten as bait-then-commit.

audit.why: Packet flagged 'Spirit Visage' in spikes[3].text as a probable misname of Spirit Fire. It is a false positive — Spirit Visage is a real item Nasus builds, and the sentence is about his itemisation, not his E.

notes: Two real errors corrected, both about the same interaction. (1) The page said in four places that Ragnarok cleanses Wither. It does not — Ragnarok is immunity to disables while attacking; Wither is a Move Speed and Attack Speed decay and it lands and persists through R. This matches the mirror audit's finding. (2) The content layer twice stated Nasus has no Wither until level 6; Wither is his W, available from level 2. Level chart also rewritten: the old chart gave Olaf the First item and 2+ items rows on a matchup the same page rates 10/10 carry threat for Nasus. Packet suspectName 'Spirit Visage' is a false positive — it is the item, not a misspelling of Spirit Fire. KIT FLAG MISFIRE: olaf.json tags Undertow with grounding; Riot's description is damage plus Armor and Move Speed reduction only, so no grounding claim was written.
